name: Free of cost restrictions
definition: Free from cost and restrictions to use.
compliant_when: The specification can be obtained, implemented and redistributed at no cost, under an open licence, with no membership, registration or accreditation required.
partially_compliant_when: The specification is free of charge, but obtaining or using it requires registration or membership, or its licence adds terms that limit use (for example non-commercial or no-derivatives clauses).
not_compliant_when: Obtaining or implementing the specification requires a purchase, a paid membership or a subscription, or its licence does not permit implementation or redistribution.

name: Publicly documented
compliant_when: The complete specification text is published on a public web page or repository and can be read by anyone, without an account or payment.
partially_compliant_when: Part of the specification is public, but some sections, profiles or schemas are only available on request, after registration, or for a fee.
not_compliant_when: The specification text is not publicly available, or only a summary or abstract is public.

name: Independent maintainer
definition: Actively maintained by an independent organization with no business interest in the contents of the standard.
compliant_when: An identified organization actively maintains the specification, and its business interests are not, and would not reasonably appear to be, affected by the contents of the specification.
partially_compliant_when: A maintainer exists, but its independence is limited: the governing body is led by industry participants, a single company or agency keeps significant control, or maintenance is irregular.
not_compliant_when: No organization actively maintains the specification, or the maintainer's own business interests are directly affected by its contents.

name: Structured releases
definition: Contains structured releases, versions, or changelogs.
compliant_when: The specification is published in numbered versions with a public changelog or release notes.
partially_compliant_when: Changes are publicly visible (for example in a repository's commit history), but there are no numbered releases or no changelog.
not_compliant_when: No versions or change history are published.

name: Open governance
definition: Has an open community of contributors and users, and transparent, inclusive governance.
compliant_when: Anyone can propose changes and take part in decisions on equal terms, through a documented, public process.
partially_compliant_when: Anyone can contribute or comment in public, but decisions are taken by a closed group, or the decision process is not documented.
not_compliant_when: Taking part in changes or decisions requires a paid membership, or decisions are taken without any public process.

name: Fully compliant
definition: Bonus for a specification that meets every principle.
not_compliant_when: At least one principle is not compliant.

name: Adoption
partially_compliant_when: early or pilot: early adopters or pilot deployments.
